rationale: I read the complete held EO 13508 (74 FR 23099, May 12, 2009, 'Chesapeake Bay Protection and Restoration'): it sets the policy, creates the Federal Leadership Committee chaired by EPA, requires agency reports, strategy and annual action plans, and carries general provisions; its dated items are report and strategy deadlines (which never end an order), and it has no own sunset and no savings clause. I read the complete held EO 14428 (91 FR 59975, Sept. 16, 2026, 'Providing Meaningful Water Quality Improvements Through Collaboration and Oversight of Federal Support'): sec. 2 reads in full 'Executive Order 13508 is hereby revoked', unconditional and with no delayed effective date or savings clause; sec. 3 sets new, separate agency direction on prioritizing Bay-health funding and sec. 4 holds general provisions; sec. 4(a)-(b) contain no transition language that keeps EO 13508 operating. The signing date of Sept. 16, 2026 is before the Oct. 14, 2026 cutoff and the order was published Sept. 21, 2026, so it is within the checked window. D6 self-check: the history has only the EO 14428 revocation (two catalog leads from the same source); a search of the held corpus for 'Chesapeake Bay Protection and Restoration' and 'Order 13508' finds only EO 13508 and EO 14428, so no order amended, revived or extended EO 13508 after 2009 or after the revocation, and no earlier ending exists in the held record. Provisional NO hypothesis only; the 2026 order is recent and a later reversal after Oct. 14, 2026 is outside the checked window.
